children: {b:{u:Definitions}}

children.name: text
children: {b:Contractor} means BANKS DESIGN & BUILD LIMITED (No. 07123098) whose registered office is at Office 4.03 Greenside House, 50 Station Road, London N22 7DE and any permitted assigns.
{br}
{b:Contractor’s Representative} means the person representing the Contractor whose name may be notified from time to time by the Contractor to the Subcontractor.
{br}
{b:Days} shall be computed as clear days to include Saturday, Sunday, or Bank Holidays, unless expressed as working days.
{br}
{b:Due Date} means the due date for payment.
{br}
{b:Defects Correction Period} or {b:Defects Liability Period} or {b:Maintenance Period} or {b:Rectification Period} or similar expressions shall have the meaning ascribed under the Main Contract.
{br}
{b:Employer} means the person or company employing the Contractor under the Main Contract.
{br}

{b:Employer’s Representative} means any agent of the Employer under the Main Contract such as Architect, Engineer, Quantity Surveyor or other person whose name may be notified from time to time by the Contractor to the Subcontractor.
{br}

{b:Environmental Laws} means all laws (including statutory law, subordinate legislation, common law, judicial decisions and the law of the European Union insofar as it has legally binding effect and notices issued by any Competent Authority), treaties, codes of practice and guidance notes having legally binding effect from time to time subsisting or in force which are concerned with the Environment or have as a purpose or effect the protection of the environment or the health and safety of humans;
{br}
{b:Final Application} means the final application issued by the Subcontractor stating all sums that the Subcontractor considers due on completion of the Subcontract Works.
{br}
{b:Main Contract} means the contract between the Employer and the Contractor a copy of which has been made available to the Subcontractor and/or is available for inspection at the Site.
{br}
{b:Main Contract Works} means the work to be carried out by the Contractor under the Main Contract.
{br}
{b:Order} means the Subcontract Order to which these Conditions are attached, issued by the Contractor appointing the Subcontractor to carry out the Subcontract Works.
{br}
{b:Interim Payment Notice / Payment Notice} – An Interim Payment Notice, Payment Notice or Payment Certificate.
{br}

{b:Pricing Document} means the bill of quantities, contract sum analysis (CSA), price schedule or other document or documents identifying the Subcontractor’s prices, included in the Subcontract or referred to therein.
{br}
{b:Site} means the place or places where the Main Contract Works and the Subcontract Works are to be carried out, as described in the Subcontract.
{br}

{b:Statutory Consents} means any statutory approvals, consents, licences permissions (including Planning Permissions and Environmental Permits), certificates and statutory agreements required from any local or other Competent Authority to enable the Developer lawfully to carry out and complete the Works or to reinstate the Works following their damage or destruction and includes the approval of reserved matters under any planning permission;
{br}

{b:Statutory Requirements} means all or any of the following:- (s) Acts of Parliament and statutory instruments, rules, orders, regulations, notices, directions, bye-laws and permissions for the time being made under or deriving validity from any Act of Parliament; (b) European directives or regulations and rules having the force of law in England; and (c) regulations, orders, bye-laws or codes of practice of any local or statutory authority having jurisdiction over the Subcontract Works;
{br}
{b:Statement of Final Account} means the finalisation of all sums due to the Subcontractor under this agreement.
{br}

{b:Subcontract} means the agreement between the Contractor and the Subcontractor comprising the Order, these Terms and Conditions and such other documents as are specified in the Order together with those documents that are referred to therein.
{br}
{b:Subcontractor} means the company named in the Order, entering into the Subcontract with the Contractor.
{br}
{b:Subcontract Price} means the price entered in the Order which is exclusive of VAT.
{br}
{b:Schedule of Rates} means the Schedule of Rates, if any included, referred to in the Subcontract.
{b:Subcontract Works} means the work to be carried out by the Subcontractor, as described in the documents included in the Subcontract.

children.name: text
children: {b:Order of Precedence}

children.name: text
children: In case of ambiguity or discrepancy between any of the documents incorporated in the Subcontract such ambiguity or discrepancy shall be resolved by giving effect first to the Order and then these Conditions, then to those documents produced by the Contractor, pre-order minutes, programme and then those documents produced by the Subcontractor. The terms contained in the Subcontract and the documents referred to therein are the entire terms of the agreement between the parties.

children.name: text
children: {b:Subletting and Assignment}

children.name: text
children: The Subcontractor shall not assign or transfer this Subcontract or any interest, obligations or rights arising hereunder whether in whole or in part, nor shall the Subcontractor sublet the whole or any part of the Subcontract Works without the prior written consent of the Contractor. If the Contractor gives such consent, the Subcontractor shall draw the attention of the Subcontractor’s suppliers and Subcontractors to the provisions of the Subcontract insofar as they affect those suppliers and Subcontractors.

children.name: text
children: The Contractor shall be entitled to assign its entire rights and obligations in this Subcontract at any time but shall give the Subcontractor written notice of the assignment within 20 working days.

children.name: text
children: The Subcontractor shall not sub-contract or delegate or allow any other person to perform any of its obligations hereunder without the prior written consent of the Contractor. No such consent given by the Contractor shall relieve the Subcontractor from its responsibility for the proper performance of those obligations. The Subcontractor shall be fully responsible for any acts, omissions, defaults or breaches of contract of all sub-subcontractors and suppliers employed by the Subcontractor, or their respective agents, as fully as if they were the acts, omissions, defaults or breaches of contract of the Subcontractor or his servants or agents.

children.name: text
children: Notwithstanding any other provision hereof, no direction, admission, approach, consent, approval, confirmation, sanction, acknowledgement, advice or absence of objection made or given by or on behalf of the Contractor shall in any way relieve the Subcontractor from its liabilities or obligations hereunder, nor shall such liabilities or obligations be restricted or qualified in any way. Should the Contractor issue an instruction pursuant to the Subcontract which could in any way be deemed to relieve the Subcontractor from his liabilities or obligations or be against statute or good building practice, then the Subcontractor shall notify the Contractor in writing of the effect of such instruction and the Contractor shall then confirm whether or not the instruction remains effective within seven days.

children.name: text
children: {b:General Obligations}

children.name: text
children: The Subcontractor acknowledges that details of the Main Contract (other than the Contractor’s prices) were made available for its inspection at the Contractor’s office, and that it has full knowledge of the terms of the Main Contract except for the Contractor’s prices.

children.name: text
children: The Subcontractor shall be deemed to have ascertained fully and shall accept responsibility for the ascertainment of the physical and other conditions of the Site, its surroundings and all existing structures thereon including without limitation the ground to be excavated or built on or both, the subsurface conditions, the hydrological and climatic conditions and any existing underground services and structures on the Site and the extent and nature of the work and materials necessary for constructing and completing the Subcontract Works, and in general to have obtained for itself and fully acquainted itself with all necessary information as to risks, contingencies and all other circumstances which may affect the Subcontract Price or the Pricing Document before submitting its offer. The Subcontractor shall not be entitled to rely on any surveys, reports or other documents supplied to it by or on behalf of the Employer or the Contractor regarding the said physical or other conditions. The Subcontractor shall not be entitled to any increase in the Subcontract Price or to the prices entered in the Pricing Document or to any extension of time for completion of the Subcontract Works due to physical or other conditions, or any risk, contingency or other circumstances.

children.name: text
children: The Subcontractor shall familiarise itself with the programme and key dates set out in the Order to ensure sufficient labour materials and plant are made available to progress and complete the Subcontract works in accordance with the dates set out in the Order. The Subcontractor shall also carry out and complete the Subcontract Works regularly and diligently and in a good and workmanlike manner to the reasonable satisfaction of the Contractor and the Employer and in accordance with current Building Regulations, British Standards and British Standard Codes of Practice, Local Authority Regulations, statutory undertakers’ requirements, specifications and all other applicable rules, regulations and terms implied by common law, statute, trade custom and usage, or otherwise. The Subcontractor shall provide everything that is necessary for the carrying out and completion of the Subcontract Works in accordance with such drawings, specifications, programmes and instructions supplied by the Contractor to the Subcontractor from time to time. The Subcontract Works shall be carried out in such order and at such times and in such manner as the Contractor shall direct or require. The Subcontractor will not be granted exclusive use of the Site and shall cooperate with and not impede the Contractor or any other Subcontractor who may be working on or adjacent to the Site.
The Contractor does not guarantee continuity of work on the Site and reserves the right to phase or amend the timing of the Subcontract Works without incurring liability.

children.name: text
children: The Subcontractor warrants that the Subcontract Works will be carried out in a proper and workmanlike manner using new materials of the best and of sound and merchantable quality and of the kinds and standards described in the Main Contract so that the Subcontract Works are fit for the purpose intended. If at any time the Contractor notifies the Subcontractor of any defect in the Subcontract Works the Subcontractor shall immediately rectify the same, failing which the Contractor may instruct others to rectify the said defect or carry out the rectification itself, and may recover the cost thereof from the Subcontractor as a debt or set off the said cost from any amount otherwise due to the Subcontractor.

children.name: text
children: Where part or all of the Main Contract Works are to be executed in accordance with a Quality System, the Subcontractor is deemed to have allowed in its Subcontract Price or Pricing Document or Schedules of Rates for complying with the requirements of the Quality System which relates to the Subcontract Works.

children.name: text
children: The Subcontractor shall carry out, complete and maintain the Subcontract Works so that no act or omission of it in relation thereto shall constitute, cause or contribute to any breach of the Main Contract by the Contractor, and the Subcontractor shall assume and perform hereunder all the liabilities and obligations of the Contractor under the Main Contract. Without prejudice to the generality of the provisions contained herein, the Subcontractor shall serve on the Contractor such notices as are required by the Main Contract so that the Contractor is thereby enabled to comply with the notice provisions of the Main Contract. It is expressly agreed that any failure by the Subcontractor to serve such notices as aforesaid shall be a breach of the Subcontract by the Subcontractor.

children.name: text
children: The Subcontractor shall not be entitled to any addition to the Subcontract price if it fails to comply with any provision in the Subcontract (including for the avoidance of doubt but without limitation provisions relating to time) by which the Subcontractor is required to serve notices on the Contractor or to provide details or estimates.

children.name: text
children: Notwithstanding any other provision of this Subcontract the Subcontract Price shall only be increased in accordance with and subject to the express provisions of these terms and conditions. For the avoidance of doubt:

children.name: text
children: The Subcontractor is deemed to have allowed within the Subcontract Price an amount for all the necessary making good and attendance on the Subcontract Works and all trades appertaining to the Subcontract Works, both prior to and following the carrying out of the Subcontract Works on site, in accordance with normal trade practice.

children.name: text
children: This Subcontract is placed on a fixed price basis for the Subcontract Works and (unless otherwise agreed in writing with the Contractor) is not subject to fluctuations in either labour, plant, material or supervision costs.

children.name: text
children: The Subcontract Price shall be deemed to include any and all of the requirements and/or works as set out in the Subcontract documents referred to in the Order (notwithstanding any qualifications or exclusions that may have been provided for in any document produced by the Subcontractor, whether or not such document of the Subcontractor has been included within the Order).

children.name: text
children: The Subcontract Price shall be inclusive of all labour materials (where applicable) attendances hand and power tools access platforms temporary lighting and any other plant required to carry out the Subcontract Works.

children.name: text
children: The Subcontractor shall start work on Site within seven days of the Contractor’s written notice to proceed. The Subcontractor shall execute the Subcontract Works for the Subcontract Price upon and subject to the terms of the Subcontract to the Contractor's satisfaction and the Subcontract Works shall be completed no later than the period or periods or time or times stated in the Order.

children.name: text
children: The Contractor shall give the Subcontractor such access to the Site as may be necessary for the Subcontractor to carry out the Subcontract Works.

children.name: text
children: The Subcontractor shall comply with all site regulations in force such as but not limited to health and safety, working hours, materials storage, welfare facilities, noise and no smoking, as the Contractor may notify the Subcontractor from time to time.

children.name: text
children: The Subcontractor warrants that it has familiarised itself with both the statutory and the Contractor’s health and safety requirements and that it has fully informed its labour of those requirements and its obligations thereunder. Compliance with the said requirements is mandatory. The Subcontractor is deemed to have allowed in its Subcontract Price or Pricing Document or Schedule of Rates for complying with all health and safety requirements. The Subcontractor shall provide all information reasonably required by the Contractor to comply with the CDM Regulations including supplying information required for the completion of the health and safety files.

children.name: text
children: The Subcontractor shall provide all plant, materials, labour, transport and supervision and any other resources as are necessary for the Subcontractor to carry out and complete the Subcontract Works, other than the facilities to be provided by the Contractor as set out in the Subcontract. Any further items provided by the Contractor to the Subcontractor shall be charged at cost plus the percentage stated in the Order, or if none is stated 25%. The Subcontractor shall indemnify the Contractor against all damage to and replacement costs caused to the Contractor’s facilities until the Subcontract Works have been certified by the Contractor as substantially complete.

children.name: text
children: The Subcontractor shall comply with the instructions issued by the Contractor’s Representative including any instructions of the Employer’s Representative which may be passed on by the Contractor’s Representative to the Subcontractor. If at any time the Subcontractor fails to carry out an instruction the Contractor may instruct others (or itself) carry out the required actions/works and may recover the cost thereof from the Subcontractor as a debt or set off the said cost from any amount otherwise due to the Subcontractor.

children.name: text
children: Goods and materials used in the Subcontract Works shall be of good quality, fit for the purpose intended and in accordance with the Main Contract. Where no specification is mentioned in the Main Contract the goods and materials shall comply with the British Standard or code of practice or such other industry standard as may be applicable. Any instruction, whether given verbally or in writing by the Contractor or any of its agents to the Subcontractor or his appointed supervisor or agents to open up for inspection the Subcontract Works and/or rectify any sub-standard work, must receive the Subcontractor's prompt attention at its own cost.

children.name: text
children: The Contractor may, at its absolute discretion, accept any unsatisfactory work or work which is not in accordance with the Main Contract and abate any sum which would otherwise be due to the Subcontractor by such amount as the Contractor may consider to be reasonable.

children.name: text
children: The Subcontractor shall allow the Contractor’s Representative and the Employer’s Representative to inspect the Subcontractor’s work, goods or materials whether on or off the Site at such times as the Contractor may reasonably require.

children.name: text
children: The Subcontractor shall satisfy itself that any work which precedes the Subcontract Works has been properly executed. No warranty is given by the Contractor as to the positions, dimensions, levels or suitability of any work previously carried out by any other Contractor or other Subcontractor and the Subcontractor shall, before commencing the Subcontract Works, notify the Contractor in writing if any previous work is unsatisfactory. The Subcontractor shall not be entitled to make any claim against the Contractor in respect of any such previous work or for any loss, damage or expense incurred by the Subcontractor as a result of any previous work being unsatisfactory unless notice has been given by the Subcontractor in accordance with these provisions.

children.name: text
children: The Subcontractor shall in accordance with the requirements of the Contractor afford all reasonable access to and facilities for any other contractors and their subcontractors employed by the Employer and other subcontractors employed by the Contractor and any authorities or statutory bodies which may be employed on or near the Site.

children.name: text
children: The Subcontractor shall cooperate fully with the Contractor and shall provide advice to the Contractor to enable the Contractor to fulfil its obligations under the Main Contract. The Subcontractor agrees to be bound by the decision of any person appointed under the Main Contract to decide any matters or to resolve any disputes arising thereunder.

children.name: text
children: The Subcontractor shall duly observe and perform and shall use best endeavours to procure that each of the sub-subcontractors and suppliers employed by the Subcontractor shall duly observe and perform the obligations imposed upon the Contractor by any agreement entered into between the Contractor and any interested third party affecting the carrying out and completion of the Subcontract Works provided always that this obligation shall apply only insofar as relevant extracts from such agreements have been supplied to the Subcontractor whether before or after the date of this Subcontract. In the event of any conflict between the provisions of any such agreement and any other provision of this Subcontract, the provisions of this Subcontract shall prevail unless otherwise instructed by the Contractor.

children.name: text
children: The Subcontractor shall maintain responsibility and liability for all his materials, plant and goods or those provided to the Subcontractor by the Contractor, which are on site or partially fixed until these are fully and finally incorporated into the Subcontract Works. The Subcontractor shall be responsible for the unloading, safe storage, distribution and placing of all goods and materials it brings to Site.

children.name: text
children: The Subcontract shall not specify for or use in the Subcontract Works any products, substances or materials which are deleterious or hazardous to health and safety or to the durability of buildings and / or other structures and / or finishes and / or plant and machinery in the particular circumstances in which they are to be used or which are not in accordance with the guidance contained in the current edition of “Good Practice in the Selection of Construction Materials” (sponsored by the British Council for Offices). Should the Subcontractor become aware that any substance has been specified for use or used in the Subcontract Works otherwise than in accordance with this sub-clause 3.23, it shall inform the Contractor immediately.

children.name: text
children: {b:Protection of the Subcontract Works, Trespass and Nuisance}

children.name: text
children: The Subcontractor shall ensure that all necessary adequate temporary works and measures are provided, and precautions are taken to protect the Subcontract Works and materials on Site for incorporation in the Subcontract Works from damage.

children.name: text
children: The Subcontractor will at its own expense provide erect and (after completion of the Subcontract Works) remove all protection necessary for the safe execution of the Subcontract Works from commencement, during execution and up to Practical Completion of the Main Contract Works. The Subcontractor shall be responsible for the protection of the work of others where it could be reasonably envisaged that damage to the work of others might occur due to the execution of the Subcontract Works.

children.name: text
children: The Subcontractor will be held entirely responsible for the adequacy of the protection afforded and it shall make good any damage caused by the execution of the Subcontract Works to the Main Contract Works, the Site and to works of and materials supplied by any other trades on Site at its own expense. Should the Subcontractor wish to be reimbursed for the making good of damage caused by others to the Subcontract Works, it will be a condition precedent to payment that the Subcontractor shall provide sufficient documentation and proof to the Contractor to enable all such costs to be recovered by the Contractor from the offending person.

children.name: text
children: The Subcontractor shall carry out the Subcontract Works without infringing any rights, reservations, covenants, restrictions, stipulations or other encumbrances binding on or affecting the Site and shall at all times prevent any trespass, public or private nuisance (including, without limitation, any such nuisance caused by noxious fumes, noisy working operations or the deposit of any material or debris on the public highway) or other interference with the rights and activities of any adjoining or neighbouring landowner, tenant or occupier or any statutory undertaker arising out of the carrying out of the Subcontract Works or of any obligation pursuant to sub-clause 7.4 and shall assist the Contractor in defending any action or proceedings which may be instituted in relation thereto. The Subcontractor shall be liable to the Contractor from and against any and all expenses, liabilities, losses, claims and proceedings whatsoever resulting from any such trespass, nuisance or interference, save only where such trespass, nuisance or interference is the consequence of a variation pursuant to sub-clause 9 or other instruction of the Contractor (which is not itself the result of any negligence, default or breach of contract by or on behalf of the Subcontractor or any of its Subcontractors or suppliers) and has not been avoided despite the Subcontractor using all reasonable and practical means to avoid the same. For the avoidance of doubt, the Contractor may issue to the Subcontractor such instructions as he considers necessary if any injunction is granted or court order is made in consequence of any such trespass, nuisance or interference, but (save as aforesaid) no such instruction shall be construed as a variation pursuant to sub-clause 9.

children.name: text
children: {b:Design}

children.name: text
children: Where the Subcontract imposes design responsibilities on the Subcontractor, whether expressly stated or otherwise, the Subcontractor warrants that:

children.name: text
children: It has exercised and will continue to exercise all the skill and care in the design of the Subcontract Works to be expected of a specialised and competent designer experienced in projects of similar complexity, type and nature to the Subcontract Works (including experience of managing and coordinating the design and execution of the Subcontract Works).

children.name: text
children: Without prejudice to sub–clause 5.1.1 that it shall ensure that the Subcontract Works will, when completed, be reasonably fit for the purpose intended and will comply with any performance specification or requirement contained within the requirements, the provisions of the Main Contract and will be in compliance with British Standards and Codes of Practice where applicable and any other applicable industry standards and laws.

children.name: text
children: The Subcontractor shall ensure that its designs are compatible and coordinated with the designs of the Contractor or others as may be notified to the Subcontractor from time to time. The Subcontractor shall as necessary or when requested to do so by the Contractor submit to the Contractor three copies of all designs, drawings, details, documents and any other information prepared as part of the Subcontractor’s designs and shall submit such further information as the Contractor requires as may be necessary from time to time to explain or amplify the Subcontractor’s designs and intentions in respect of the Subcontract Works. The Subcontractor shall further submit at the request of the Contractor such information as is reasonably necessary to explain or amplify the effect of the Subcontractor’s designs on the works to enable the Contractor to carry out the design of the works under the Main Contract and to obtain the Employer’s approval or consent to such design. The submissions shall be made at such times as are appropriate having regard to the programmes for the carrying out of the works and the Subcontract Works and any requirements or procedures in the Main Contract and the Subcontract for approvals or consents to be given.

children.name: text
children: Notwithstanding the above, where the Order states that the Subcontract Works are to include design, the Subcontractor accepts entire responsibility for the design of the Subcontract Works (including all design work prepared before or after the date hereof) and whether carried out by or on behalf any other party, all designs set out in the Order and for any mistake, inaccuracy, discrepancy or omission contained in the same. The Subcontractor shall be deemed to have scrutinised, prior to the date of this agreement, all the Subcontract documents as referred to in the Order and any mistake, inaccuracy, discrepancy or omission in the Subcontract documents shall be corrected at the Subcontractor's cost in accordance with the Contractor's instructions and without entitlement to any extension of time.

children.name: text
children: The Subcontractor shall co-ordinate its design through the Contractor with all relevant interfacing works to the extent that details of such interfacing works are made known by the Contractor to the Subcontractor prior to or during its design activity period.

children.name: text
children: {b:Temporary Works Design}

children.name: text
children: The Subcontractor shall be responsible for:

children.name: text
children: The design of the temporary works necessary for the construction of the Subcontract Works; and

children.name: text
children: The selection of materials and goods for the temporary works necessary for the construction of the Subcontract Works; and

children.name: text
children: The satisfaction of any performance specification or requirements insofar as such performance specification or requirements are included in the Subcontract or the Main Contract; and shall indemnify and keep indemnified the Contractor against any damage, expense, liability, loss or claim that the Contractor may incur arising out of or in consequence of the Subcontractor’s failure to comply with its said responsibilities.

children.name: text
children: The Subcontractor shall provide such design calculations, drawings, method statements or other details in relation to the design of the temporary works as may be required by the Contractor.

children.name: text
children: Where temporary works are to be incorporated in the works, the Subcontractor shall provide a competent temporary works supervisor to supervise the installation, maintenance, inspection and dismantling of the temporary works.

children.name: text
children: {b:Practical Completion and Defects}

children.name: text
children: When the Subcontractor is satisfied that the Subcontract Works are practically complete the Subcontractor shall notify the Contractor in writing and provided that Contractor is of the opinion that the Subcontract Works are complete and virtually (if not completely) snag free with all areas cleaned to an acceptable standard (minimum builders clean standard) and the Subcontractor has complied with all stages of the Contractor’s handover plan, the Contractor will issue a certificate to that effect to the Subcontractor.

children.name: text
children: Notwithstanding any other provision in this Subcontract, the Subcontract Works shall not be deemed to have reached practical completion for the purpose of this Subcontract until the Subcontractor has supplied to the Contractor all documentation and items listed below or the actions listed below are complete in relation to the Subcontract Works:

children.name: text
children: All mechanical and electrical services and as built drawings, manuals, warranties, maintenance booklets, guarantees (including product guarantees and twelve year insurance backed guarantees in forms approved by the Contractor with respect to the workmanship and products used in relation to any roofing, waterproofing and/or tanking works), manufactures’ and suppliers’ warranties, certificates and commissioning documentation and other documentation howsoever relating to the Subcontract Works as are necessary and reasonably required for the proper use, operation and maintenance of the Subcontract Works;

children.name: text
children: All obligations and requirements detailed in the Main Contract and the Subcontract for approval or consent have been given;

children.name: text
children: If requested by the Contractor, duly executed original deeds of collateral warranties in the agreed forms in accordance with the provisions of clause 17;

children.name: text
children: Any health and safety files and Operating Manuals in respect of the Subcontract Works; and

children.name: text
children: Any other matters of compliance as referred to in the Order.

children.name: text
children: Where the Subcontract Works are certified as practically completed but any of the abovementioned drawings, manuals, warranties, guarantees, certificates, documents have not been provided by the Subcontractor no further sum shall become due from the Contractor to the Subcontractor until the Subcontractor has provided all such documentation.

children.name: text
children: Without prejudice to sub-clause 7.2, two months prior to the anticipated date of practical completion, the Subcontractor shall provide to the Contractor a schedule and draft copies of the as-built information to be provided by the Subcontractor in accordance with sub-clause 7.2.1. The Subcontractor shall provide to the Contractor the final as-built information prior to practical completion in accordance with sub-clause 7.2.1. Such information shall show and describe the works as-built, the operation and maintenance of all elements of the building including any service installations and shall include copies of all relevant manufacturer’s literature, statutory certificates etc. as set out in the schedule.

children.name: text
children: Unless otherwise stated in the Order, the Defects Correction Period shall commence from the date stated on the said certificate and end thirteen months after the date of practical completion of the Main Contract Works under the Main Contract. During the Defects Correction Period, the Subcontractor must rectify any and all defects, including, without limitation, omissions, sub-standard or incomplete work/commissioning, snags, shrinkages and any other fault and/or any outstanding documentation or obligation, and any damage to property caused by the same (“defects”) in connection with the Subcontract Works within the prescribed timescale for that defect: (i) if specified as 'emergency defects/works' within 4 hours of receipt of a notice from the Contractor or Employer; (ii) if specified as 'essential defects/works' within 24 hours of receipt of a notice from the Contractor or Employer; (iii) all other defects within 7 days of receipt of a notice from the Contractor or Employer. Any costs or losses incurred by the Contractor and/or the Employer attributable to any defects in the Subcontract Works will be reimbursed by the Subcontractor to the Contractor.

children.name: text
children: Where such defects are not rectified within the designated timescale, then the Contractor may (at its discretion) employ another contractor to carry out the works and all costs direct or indirect (including, without limitation, any management time) and any loss of profit will be deducted/claimed from the Subcontractor as a debt.

children.name: text
children: Notwithstanding the above the Contractor may (at its absolute discretion): (i) employ another contractor to (or itself) carry out the remediation works in relation to any defect and all associated costs direct or indirect (including, without limitation, any management time) and any loss of profit will be deducted/claimed from the Subcontractor; or (ii) make an appropriate deduction/claim in respect of any such defect against the Subcontractor’s account as a debt.

children.name: text
children: {b:Extensions of Time}

children.name: text
children: The Subcontractor shall not be entitled to claim an extension of time for any delay event that has not been notified to the Contractor in accordance with this Clause 8 within five days of the occurrence of such delay event and proper details of the effects of the delay event within 10 days thereafter. Compliance with this provision is a condition precedent to the Subcontractor’s entitlement to an extension of time.

children.name: text
children: If for reasons beyond the control of the Subcontractor the execution of the Subcontract Works is delayed the Subcontractor shall notify the Contractor of the reason for the delay. Subject to sub-clause 8.1 such notification shall be given in writing as soon as possible. Subject to the above and the following, the Contractor shall allow the Subcontractor such extension of time for completion of the Subcontract Works as is reasonable in the circumstances. The Subcontractor shall also be allowed a reasonable extension of time where it properly suspends the performance of any or all of its obligations under the Subcontract pursuant to sub-clause 28.2.

children.name: text
children: However, the Subcontractor shall not be allowed an extension of time if and to the extent that any delay in the regular progress of the Subcontract Works is caused by an act, omission or default of the Contractor, its servants or agents including other subcontractors which is concurrent with another delay for which the Subcontractor is responsible.

children.name: text
children: The Subcontractor must use its best endeavours to prevent and mitigate any incurred or anticipated delay to the Subcontract Works and it is a condition precedent of any entitlement to the granting of any extension of time that the Subcontractor uses such best endeavours.

children.name: text
children: If there is any delay in the delivery to the site of materials or goods forming part of the Subcontract Works and/or if there is any delay to the progress of the Subcontract Works and such delay or delays are attributable to effects of the coronavirus, any other pandemic, epidemic or the like within the UK and/or abroad the Contractor may at its sole discretion omit the whole or any of the Subcontract Works and have such whole or any part either carried out by the Contractor or arrange for the whole or omitted portion to be carried out by others. In such case the Subcontract Price shall be reduced by the amount which represents the value of the Subcontract Works omitted and the Subcontractor shall not be entitled to any damages or compensation or loss of overheads and/or profits whatsoever.

children.name: text
children: Notwithstanding any other provision of this Subcontract the Contractor and Subcontractor agree that:

children.name: text
children: Delayed importation of materials and/or goods from the European Union for use in the works shall not be treated as a delay event for the purposes of this Subcontract; and

children.name: text
children: The Contractor will have no liability for and shall not reimburse the Subcontractor in respect of any increase in tariffs, duties and/or taxes imposed by the governments of the United Kingdom and/or the European Union which are a direct result of the United Kingdom's withdrawal from the European Union and which become payable by the Subcontractor in connection with the importation of materials and/or goods from the European Union for use in the Subcontract Works; and

children.name: text
children: The Subcontractor shall not be entitled to an extension of time, loss and expense and/or addition to the Subcontract Price for any matters arising out of or in connection with the United Kingdom's withdrawal from the European Union.

children.name: text
children: The Subcontractor shall only be entitled to an extension of time in circumstances where the Contractor is entitled to and/or awarded an extension of time under the Main Contract, except where the delay is caused by an act, omission or default of the Contractor, its servants or agents including subcontractors.

children.name: text
children: The Subcontractor shall not be entitled to an extension of time in excess of that granted to the Contractor under the Main Contract. Whether or not the Subcontractor is entitled to an extension of time under the Subcontract, the Subcontractor shall reimburse the Contractor any amount for which the Contractor is liable under the Main Contract where and to the extent that such liability is caused by any act, omission or default of the Subcontractor and the Contractor may deduct such amount from any monies that may be or become due to the Subcontractor or may recover the same from the Subcontractor as a debt, save where the Subcontractor is allowed a reasonable extension of time for suspending performance of any or all of its obligations under the Subcontract pursuant to sub-clause 28.2.

children.name: text
children: If the regular progress of the Main Contract Works, or any part thereof, is affected by any act or default of the Subcontractor, his servants or agents, the amount of any direct loss and/or expense and/or damage incurred or to be incurred by the Contractor may be deducted from any monies due or to become due to the Subcontractor (whether in relation to this Subcontract or in respect of any other Subcontract and/or agreement between the Contractor and the Subcontractor) and/or shall be recoverable by the Contractor from the Subcontractor as a debt. Part of this said direct loss and/or expense and/or damage figure will be the applicable rate of liquidated damages as set out in the Main Contract. Such liability of the Subcontractor for delay shall include (without limitation) liability for any liquidated damages for which the Contractor may become liable for under the Main Contract. The Contractor shall be entitled to notify the Subcontractor of its estimated loss or damage and be entitled to deduct such estimated sums from any amount otherwise due pursuant to this Subcontract and/or claim the same as a debt from the Subcontractor.

children.name: text
children: This clause shall only apply if the Order states that liquidated damages apply to this Subcontract (i.e. greater than ‘£0’ or ‘£nil’), and if this clause does apply, notwithstanding any other provision of this Subcontract, the Subcontractor’s liability for any delay in the completion of the Subcontract Works shall not exceed the liquidated damages payable under this clause 8.10. If the Subcontractor fails to complete the Subcontract Works within the Date/Period for Completion or as agreed in writing between the parties or as extended in accordance with this Subcontract, it will pay to the Contractor on demand liquidated damages at the rate set out in the Order. The liquidated damages payments in this clause represent a genuine pre-estimate of the Contractor’s loss and does not impose a detriment on the Subcontractor which is disproportionate to the legitimate interests of the Contractor in the enforcement of the Subcontractor’s obligation to complete the Subcontract Works on time.

children.name: text
children: Without prejudice to any and all other obligations which the Subcontractor has under this Subcontract, the Subcontractor shall provide the Contractor with all necessary early warnings, applications, notices, revised cause-and-effect programme and any other communications in sufficient time and detail to enable the Contractor to comply with any obligations it may have under the Contract in relation to the provision of such early warnings, applications, notices and any other communications.

children.name: text
children: If in the opinion of the Contractor (i) the Subcontractor is failing to carry out the Subcontract Works or any part of the Subcontract Works in accordance with clause 3.3, or (ii) or the Subcontractor is unwilling, unable or unlikely to complete the Subcontract works by the date for completion set out in the Order, or (iii) the Subcontractor is failing to carry out the Subcontract Works in accordance with the requirements or standards required under this subcontract; the Contractor may, upon giving notice to the Subcontractor, and without prejudice to any of the Contractor's other rights and remedies:

children.name: text
children: perform or augment the Subcontract Works or any part of the Subcontract Works, whether by itself or by others; and/or

children.name: text
children: issue instructions to the Subcontractor omitting and removing the whole or relevant parts of the Subcontract Works from this Subcontract, and may employ others to carry out those works;

children.name: text
children: and in such event the price of the Subcontract Works shall be reduced by the value of those parts of the Subcontract Works, and any additional costs and/or expenditure incurred or loss or damage suffered by the Contractor in so doing shall be recoverable from the Subcontractor as a debt or may be deducted from any monies due or to become due to the Subcontractor under this Subcontract.

children.name: text
children: {b:Variations}

children.name: text
children: The Subcontractor shall be deemed to have made proper allowance in submitting its estimate to tender to the Contractor for any defects, extra work or other circumstances that were reasonably apparent during the tender process arising from the nature of the Site and the setting out of the Main Contract Works and Subcontract Works and no payment shall be made for any extra work unless the same is carried out upon the written instruction of the Contractor.

children.name: text
children: Any Provisional Sum within the Subcontract documents is deemed to be defined and no adjustment for preliminaries or adjustment to programme shall be made due to any instruction or execution of works against such provisional sum(s).

children.name: text
children: The Contractor may order the Subcontractor to make variations to the Subcontract Works, comprising additions, alterations or omissions or the method, timing or manner of their execution, and no such instruction will vitiate the Subcontract. All such variations shall be ordered in writing. If a variation or instruction entails a change to the Subcontract Price, and the parties are unable to agree the value of the change, the value shall be fixed by the Contractor’s Representative on the basis of the Subcontract Price or the prices entered in the Pricing Document or the Schedule of Rates. No payment will be made for variations other than for variations ordered in writing. Upon receipt of any oral instructions which the Subcontractor considers to be a variation the Subcontractor shall seek in writing immediate written confirmation of the same from the Contractor.

children.name: text
children: Without prejudice to the generality of sub-clause 9.3 above the Contractor may at its sole discretion omit the whole or any of the Subcontract Works for any reason whatsoever and to have such whole or any part either carried out by the Contractor or arrange for the whole or omitted portion to be carried out by others. In such case the Subcontract Price shall be reduced by the amount which represents the value of the Subcontract Works omitted and the Subcontractor shall not be entitled to any damages or compensation or loss of overheads and/or profits whatsoever.

children.name: text
children: In case the progress of the Subcontract Works is delayed due to variations or due to any reason beyond the control of the Subcontractor the Contractor may instruct the Subcontractor to accelerate the progress of the Subcontract Works. Such instruction shall be regarded as a variation to be valued in accordance with the provisions of sub-clause 9.3. In case the progress of the Subcontract Works is delayed due to the fault of the Subcontractor or due to what the Contractor deems to be the fault of the Subcontractor then the Subcontractor shall upon the written instructions of the Contractor accelerate the carrying out of the Subcontract Works at no additional cost to the Contractor.

children.name: text
children: The Subcontractor’s entitlement to payment for any variation shall be limited to an appropriate proportion of the amount awarded to the Contractor from the Employer in respect thereof under the Main Contract, and the Contractor shall pay the Subcontractor such sum as it considers reasonable.

children.name: text
children: Any work agreed by the Contractor to be carried out by the Subcontractor on dayworks shall be subject to the Contractor’s policy statement for dayworks:

Dayworks Sheets will only be considered for payment when accompanied by a Subcontractor Site Instruction instructing the works and endorsed by the Site Manager. Each Dayworks Sheet must make reference to the particular Site Instruction sequential number. Dayworks Sheets must be completed showing the operatives’ names and respective trade descriptions. The hours recorded are to be the actual hours worked on the operations described. Break times are not to be included when full shifts are worked. Materials used are to be quantified and plant detailed, with Plant Operators / Drivers shown separately in the labour section. All Dayworks Sheets with the stated attachments must be presented to the Site Manager for signature no later than the working day following the day when the work was carried out. The Site Manager will review the Dayworks Sheets with the Project Manager and if he approves them will sign and endorse them as approved within the next seven days. No distinction is to be made as to the level or grade of a particular operative, e.g. Foreman, Ganger, etc., for the purpose of pricing Dayworks Sheets other than skilled or unskilled operatives. The Contractor will not pay skilled rates for unskilled work if the Subcontractor chooses to use overqualified personnel. Endorsements of Dayworks Sheets “for record purposes” shall not constitute a precedent for the basis of valuation of the works recorded therein. In all cases, the basis of valuation shall be at the discretion of the Contractor.

children.name: text
children: Any variation or alteration in the extent of the Subcontract Works shall be subject to final adjustment only as provided for in this Clause 9 and the Subcontractor shall have no claim against the Contractor for any other payment or compensation in any respect.

children.name: text
children: {b:Claims}

children.name: text
children: If for any reason the Subcontractor incurs or expects to incur loss or expense arising from an act, omission or default of the Contractor, its servants or agents including other subcontractors, or in accordance with sub-clause 28.3, he shall give notice to the Contractor immediately (and in any event within 5 days of the date) the Subcontractor becomes aware of the situation giving rise or which may give rise to the loss or expense. Full details shall be supplied to the Contractor as soon as possible (and not later than 14 days) thereafter, together with supporting documentation.
The value of claims agreed by the Contractor’s Representative shall be included in the Subcontractor’s next application for payment following agreement.

children.name: text
children: Compliance by the Subcontractor with the provision of sub-clause 10.1 shall be a pre-condition to the Subcontractor’s entitlement to loss and expense and/or any other claims arising out of or in connection with this Subcontract.

children.name: text
children: {b:Payment and Notices}

children.name: text
children: The interim valuation dates for payments shall be set out in the Order or shall be set out in a document entitled the “Payment Schedule” or if no interim valuation dates for interim payments are stated therein the first interim valuation date for interim payments shall, unless agreed in writing, be the date one month after the date of the commencement of the Subcontract Works on Site and thereafter the same date at intervals of one month (unless otherwise agreed). If the first interim valuation date for an interim payment is a date that does not recur in a subsequent month the interim valuation date for that interim payment shall be the last day of that subsequent month. The last interim valuation date for interim payment shall be the period up to and including the month following practical completion of the Subcontract Works as defined in Clause 7. The due date for interim payment shall be 14 days after each interim valuation date.

children.name: text
children: 7 days before each interim valuation date the Subcontractor shall submit by hand or by pre-paid post to the Contractor’s head office, an interim application for payment for the value of the work carried out under the Subcontract up to the interim valuation date in question less retention of the amount stated in the Order or if none is stated 5% ("the Interim Application for Payment"). The Interim Application for Payment made by the Subcontractor must, to be valid, be clearly marked as such and set out as the amount due to the Subcontractor up to the relevant interim valuation date :-

children.name: text
children: Where the Order includes a milestone schedule, the total of the prices for the elements of the work separately identified in such milestone schedule properly executed and completed in accordance with the Subcontract;

children.name: text
children: Where the Order does not include a milestone schedule, the total value of the work carried out by the Subcontractor, determined in accordance with the said value shall be calculated by reference to the Pricing Document or the Schedule of Rates as the case may be or if there are no rates and prices or the rates and prices in the Order do not apply, by reference to the Subcontract Price;

children.name: text
children: Plus

children.name: text
children: The valuation of any approved variations under the Subcontract;

children.name: text
children: The amount of any loss & expense or other claim approved by the Contractor in accordance with the Subcontract terms and conditions;

children.name: text
children: Less

children.name: text
children: All amounts previously paid or notified as due to the Subcontractor by the Contractor;

children.name: text
children: Retention

children.name: text
children: and be accompanied by:

children.name: text
children: Sufficient documentary evidence to enable the Contractor to properly assess either, where clause 11.2.1 applies that the work claimed for has been properly executed and completed, or, where clause 11.2.2 applies, the total value of work properly executed; and

children.name: text
children: Details of Variations instructed by the Contractor where the Subcontractor claims additions to the Subcontract Price; and

children.name: text
children: Any other documents reasonably requested by the Contractor.

children.name: text
children: Not later than 5 days after each due date for interim payment the Contractor shall give written notice to the Subcontractor specifying the sum that it considers to be or have been due at the due date and the basis on which that sum has been calculated (the "Interim Payment Notice"). Subject to any Pay Less Notice served in accordance with sub-clause 11.6 the sum to be paid by the Contractor to the Subcontractor shall be the sum specified as due in the interim payment notice. The final date for payment (whether by the Contractor or the Subcontractor) of each interim application for payment shall be 21 days after the due date for each interim payment, as fixed by sub-clause 11.1 (or if later, 14 days after receipt of a VAT invoice from the Subcontractor for the sum due). It is immaterial if the sum specified as due in any notice referred to under this Clause 11 may be zero.

children.name: text
children: If the Contractor fails to serve an Interim Payment Notice, the Subcontractor may submit by hand or by pre-paid post to the Contractor a default payment notice ("Default Payment Notice" assessed in accordance with sub-clause 11.2) at any time after the five day period referred to in sub-clause 11.3. The final date for payment of the sum specified in the Default Payment Notice (subject to sub-clause 11.6) shall be postponed by the same number of days after the expiry of the five day period referred to in sub-clause 11.3 that the Default Payment Notice was submitted.

children.name: text
children: If the Contractor intends to pay less than the sum stated as due from it in the Interim Payment Notice or the Default Payment Notice, it shall not later than one day before the final date for payment give the Subcontractor written notice specifying the sum that it considers to be due to the Subcontractor at the date the notice is given and the basis on which that sum has been calculated (the "Pay Less Notice").

children.name: text
children: If a Pay Less Notice is served, the sum to be paid on or before the final date for payment shall be the sum stated as due in the Pay Less Notice.

children.name: text
children: Following practical completion of the Subcontract Works as defined in Clause 7, the Subcontractor shall be entitled to apply for the release of 50% of the retention. Sub-clauses 11.1 to 11.6 above shall apply to such payment save that the due date shall be six months following the date of the application for payment.

children.name: text
children: Subject to there being no defects shrinkages or other faults with the Subcontract Works following the date eighteen months after practical completion of the Subcontract Works the Subcontractor shall be entitled to apply for the release of balance of the retention. Sub-clauses 11.1 to 11.6 above shall apply to such payment save that the due date shall be the date of the application for payment (the "Retention Release Date").

children.name: text
children: In the event that the Employer enters administration within the meaning of Schedule B1 to the Insolvency Act 1986, or has an administration order made against it, or an administrative receiver or receiver or manager of its property is appointed or a resolution passed for winding up or on the making of a winding up order, or an award of sequestration on a partnership or individual’s estate or grant of a trust for its creditors or the equivalent under a foreign jurisdiction of any of the foregoing then the Contractor shall only subsequently be obliged to pay to the Subcontractor sums due pursuant to this Subcontract following receipt of such sums due from the Employer.

children.name: text
children: The Subcontractor shall not be entitled to payment for goods or materials delivered to the Site except in the absolute discretion of the Contractor. The Subcontractor shall produce proof whenever requested to do so that he has title to the said goods or materials. Upon payment therefore in whole or in part by the Contractor to the Subcontractor title to the said goods or materials shall immediately vest in the Contractor. In case the Contractor agrees to make payment in respect of goods or materials delivered to the Site the said payments shall not exceed the percentage stated in the Order or if no percentage is stated 75%. Payment by the Contractor for goods or materials shall not release the Subcontractor from its liability for the care thereof.

children.name: text
children: The Subcontractor shall not become entitled to any payment whatsoever under the Subcontract until the following documents have been completed and returned to the Contractor:

children.name: text
children: Evidence of insurance required by this Subcontract;

children.name: text
children: Any information required by H M Revenue & Customs in accordance with the Construction Industry Scheme;

children.name: text
children: Collateral warranties and product guarantees required by the Subcontract;

children.name: text
children: A Parent Company Guarantee (if the Subcontractor has a parent company);

children.name: text
children: Performance Bond (if required in the Order);

children.name: text
children: A copy of the Subcontractor’s safety policy and the name of its safety officer;

children.name: text
children: Such risk assessments and method statements as may be specified in the Subcontract documents;

children.name: text
children: Insurance documentation required by the Subcontract; or

children.name: text
children: The signed Subcontract Order.

children.name: text
children: Within thirty days of practical completion of the Subcontract Works the Subcontractor shall submit by hand or by pre-paid post to the Contractor as a final application for payment a Statement of Final Account complete with any supporting documentation required showing in detail the value of the Subcontract Works, and stating any further sum which the Subcontractor considers to be due from the Contractor to the Subcontractor or from the Subcontractor to the Contractor (as the case may be) under the Subcontract or in relation to the Subcontract Works. No later than three months after receipt by the Contractor of the aforesaid documents a Statement of Final Account will be issued by the Contractor to the Subcontractor detailing the said further sum that the Contractor considers to be due to the Subcontractor or the Contractor (as the case may be). The due date for payment of the Statement of Final Account shall be two months after the Retention Release Date ("Final Due Date").

children.name: text
children: Not later than five days after the final due date, the Contractor shall give written notice to the Subcontractor specifying the final sum that it considers to be due at the final due date and the basis on which that sum has been calculated (the "Final Payment Notice"). The Final Payment Notice may show a balance due from the Contractor to the Subcontractor or from the Subcontractor to the Contractor.

children.name: text
children: Subject to sub-clause 11.6 the final date for payment of the Final Payment Notice shall be 45 days after the final due date, as fixed by sub-clause 11.12.

children.name: text
children: If the party by whom the Final Payment Notice is stated to be payable intends to pay less than the stated balance, it shall, not later than one day before the final date for payment serve on the other party a notice specifying the sum that it considers to be due at the date the notice is given and the basis on which that sum has been calculated (the "Final Pay Less Notice"). If a Final Pay Less Notice is served, the sum to be paid on or before the final date for payment shall be the sum stated as due in the Final Pay Less Notice.

children.name: text
children: If the Final Payment Notice is not issued in accordance with sub-clause 11.13:

children.name: text
children: The Subcontractor may give written notice by hand or by pre-paid post to the Contractor (a "Default Payment Notice") stating what the Subcontractor considers to be the amount of the Final Payment Notice due to it under the Subcontract and the basis on which the sum has been calculated and, subject to any Final Pay Less Notice under sub-clause 11.16.3, the Final Payment Notice shall be that amount.

children.name: text
children: If the Subcontractor serves a Default Payment Notice, the final date for payment of the sum specified in it shall for all purposes be regarded as postponed by the same number of days after expiry of the five day period referred to in sub-clause 11.13 that the Default Payment Notice is given.

children.name: text
children: Following the Default Payment Notice the Contractor may not later than one day before the final date for payment serve a Final Pay Less Notice in accordance with sub-clause 11.15.

children.name: text
children: If the Contractor fails to pay an amount due to the Subcontractor by the final date for payment of the Final Payment Notice and fails to give a Final Pay Less Notice under Clause 11.15 then the Subcontractor will be entitled to interest on the overdue amount at the rate of 2% per annum above the Bank of England’s base rate from time to time. Such interest shall accrue on a daily basis from the final date for payment of the Final Payment Notice until actual payment of the overdue amount, whether before or after judgment. The Subcontractor acknowledges that the Contractor's liability under this Clause 11.17 is a substantial remedy for the purposes of Section 9(1) of the Late Payment of Commercial Debts (Interest) Act 1998.

children.name: text
children: {b:Set-Off}

children.name: text
children: The Contractor has the right to withhold from monies due to the Subcontractor any amounts which are owed to the Contractor by the Subcontractor arising out of or in connection with the Subcontract or any other contract between the Contractor and the Subcontractor. If at any time the Subcontractor is in breach of the provisions of the Subcontract, then, without prejudice to the foregoing, until such time as the parties have finally agreed the amount of loss or damage suffered or to be suffered by the Contractor because of such breach the Subcontractor shall pay or allow the Contractor such sum as the Contractor shall in good faith estimate as the amount of such loss or damage.

children.name: text
children: In case the Subcontractor does not maintain progress in carrying out the Subcontract Works to the entire satisfaction of the Contractor the Contractor reserves the right to supplement the Subcontractor’s labour force or such other of the Subcontractor’s resources as the Contractor may decide and the cost thereof may be recovered by the Contractor from the Subcontractor in accordance with the provisions of the previous sub-clause or otherwise recovered as a debt due to the Contractor from the Subcontractor. Without prejudice to any other rights which the Contractor has under the Subcontract the Contractor may further or alternatively instruct the Subcontractor to accelerate the carrying out of the Subcontract Works without additional cost to the Contractor.

children.name: text
children: Nothing contained in the Subcontract whether expressly or by incorporation or by implication shall in any way restrict the Contractor’s equitable or common law rights of set off. Without prejudice to the generality of the foregoing, the Contractor shall have the right to set off against any sum due to the Subcontractor whether hereunder or otherwise a fair and reasonable sum in respect of or on account of any claim or claims that have been made against the Contractor by the Employer the subject matter of which touches or concerns the Subcontract Works.

children.name: text
children: {b:Indemnity}

children.name: text
children: The Subcontractor shall indemnify and keep indemnified and save harmless the Contractor against all claims, proceedings, loss, liabilities, expense, costs or demands whatsoever arising out of or in the course of or through the carrying out of the Subcontract Works or of any obligation pursuant to Clause 7.4, provided that the same is caused or contributed to by the act, omission, neglect or default of the Subcontractor, its directors, employees, agents or its own subcontractors or suppliers.

children.name: text
children: The said indemnity shall be for all liabilities, such as but not limited to:

children.name: text
children: Delay damages (as referred to in clauses 8.9 and/or clause 8.10), loss or expense incurred by the Contractor through the Subcontractor’s failure to perform in accordance with the Subcontract;

children.name: text
children: Negligence on the part of the Subcontractor or any of its employees or because of any breach of statutory duty by the Subcontractor;

children.name: text
children: Any expense, liability, loss, claim or proceedings whatsoever arising under any statute or at common law in respect of personal injury or death of any person arising out of or in the course of or caused by the carrying out of the Subcontract Works;

children.name: text
children: Any expense, liability, loss, claim or proceedings in respect of any injury or damage whatsoever to any property real or personal due to any negligence, act, omission or default of the Subcontractor its servants or agents; and

children.name: text
children: Any other liability which the Contractor may incur to any person whatsoever and against all claims demands proceedings damages costs or expenses made against or incurred by the Contractor by reason of any breach by the Subcontractor of this Subcontract.

children.name: text
children: The Contractor may notify the Subcontractor of its estimated damages, costs, losses or expenses, arising out of the abovementioned claims, proceedings, loss, liabilities, expense, costs or demands and be entitled to deduct such estimated sums from any amount otherwise due pursuant to the Subcontract. Such estimate shall be binding and conclusive upon the Subcontractor until final determination or agreement.

children.name: text
children: {b:Insurance}

children.name: text
children: The Subcontractor shall arrange and produce satisfactory evidence of suitable insurance policies as undernoted:

children.name: text
children: All Risks insurance (in which the Contractor shall be named as the joint insured) of the Subcontract Works, together with all materials, plant and equipment for incorporation therein to the full replacement costs, including, but not limited to, professional fees and the reasonable costs of the removal and disposal of debris;

children.name: text
children: Public Liability insurance against liabilities for death of or injury to any person or loss of or damage to any property, real or personal, arising out of the performance of the Subcontract Works. Such insurance should include an Indemnity to Principal Clause. Unless otherwise stated in the Order the minimum indemnity shall be £10 million or such other minimum amount as may be fixed by law

children.name: text
children: In cases where the Subcontractor is required to carry out professional services as part of its obligations under the Subcontract (including but not limited to design) the Subcontractor shall take out Professional Indemnity insurance to cover its legal liability in respect of claims made against it as a result of any negligent act, error or omission on the part of the Subcontractor or its subcontractors or agents in the execution of the said professional services for at least £5 million on an each and every claim basis. The Subcontractor shall maintain this insurance for a period 12 years after the completion of the Subcontract Works. The Subcontractor shall provide confirmation that these Terms and Conditions and any modification thereof have been disclosed to its Professional Indemnity insurers.

children.name: text
children: The Subcontractor shall produce evidence of the insurance policy or policies whenever required to do so by the Contractor.

children.name: text
children: For the avoidance of doubt, the Subcontractor has no benefit in the Contractor’s insurance policies.

children.name: text
children: The Subcontractor shall not take or fail to take any action or permit or suffer anything to occur in relation to a joint name policy which may be taken out by the Contractor which would entitle an insurer to refuse to pay any claim or which might otherwise prejudice the policy.

children.name: text
children: No payment will be made to the Subcontractor until the Subcontractor has submitted fully completed and satisfactory details of its insurance policies to the Contractor in the form specified by the Contractor.

children.name: text
children: If the works are insured under the Main Contract by the Employer or the Contractor, the Subcontractor shall bear the insurance excess costs as it pertains to the Subcontract Works.

children.name: text
children: {b:Annual Holidays}

children.name: text
children: Attention is drawn to the fact that under the annual holidays agreement the Site may be closed down for periods while the Subcontractor’s work is in progress. The Subcontractor shall be deemed to have included in the Subcontract Price or Pricing Document or Schedule of Rates for any additional costs due to the phasing of its work in progress to suit the requirements of this Clause.

children.name: text
children: {b:Statutory Requirements}

children.name: text
children: The Subcontractor shall comply and carry out the Subcontract Works in accordance with all relevant Statutory Requirements and all Statutory Consents and in accordance with all Environmental Laws including the giving of all notices and the paying of all fees applicable to the Subcontract Works.

children.name: text
children: The Subcontractor shall comply with all requirements of Premier, BLP, NHBC or equivalent homebuilder insurance guarantor entity (if relevant).

children.name: text
children: {b:Collateral Warranties}

children.name: text
children: In case the Contractor requires that the Subcontractor shall provide collateral warranties to third parties the Subcontractor shall comply with such requirements.

children.name: text
children: The Subcontractor shall provide confirmation that such warranties have been disclosed to its Professional Indemnity insurers.

children.name: text
children: As a condition precedent to payment by the Contractor under the Subcontract:

children.name: text
children: Within 14 days of the Subcontractor commencing work on Site, the Subcontractor shall execute and deliver to the Contractor warranties in the form set out in the Main Contract with such amendments as the Contractor may reasonably require in favour of the Employer and any other persons required by the Main Contract. If the Subcontractor does not execute and deliver a deed of collateral warranty in accordance with this clause 17.3.1, the Contractor may execute that deed on the Subcontractor's behalf, and the Subcontractor hereby appoints the Contractor as the Subcontractor's attorney for the purpose of executing that deed and the Subcontractor agrees to ratify and confirm any act done by the Contractor pursuant to this power of attorney and agrees that this power is irrevocable pursuant to section 4, Powers of Attorney Act 1971.; and

children.name: text
children: The Subcontractor shall procure that within seven days of any person employed by the Subcontractor (including such as without limitation subcontractors and designers) commencing work on Site or any supplier to the Subcontractor for the Subcontract Works commencing the supply of services, such person or supplier shall execute and deliver to the Contractor such warranties (along with a complete copy of the relevant sub-subcontract) the Contractor may require in favour of the Contractor and any other person required by the Contractor. Such warranties shall be in a form substantially similar to the form of warranty required by the Main Contract or the form of warranty as appended to this Subcontract.

children.name: text
children: {b:Value Added Tax}

children.name: text
children: All rates and prices in the Subcontract are exclusive of applicable Value Added Tax.

children.name: text
children: {b:Third Parties}

children.name: text
children: Other than as may be expressly stated herein, nothing in this Subcontract purports to confer on any third party any benefit or right to enforce any term of the Subcontract.

children.name: text
children: {b:Termination of the Main Contract}

children.name: text
children: If the Main Contract is terminated the Subcontract may also be terminated at the discretion of the Contractor. The Contractor shall bear no liability for any loss or expense suffered by the Subcontractor and shall not be obliged to make any further payments to the Subcontractor in the event of the termination of the Main Contract or the Subcontract save to the extent that payments are received by the Contractor from the Employer. Any payment shall be dealt with as a final application for payment as set out in sub-clauses 11.12 to 11.16 and as if practical completion of the Subcontract Works had been achieved.

children.name: text
children: {b:Termination of the Subcontractor’s Employment}

children.name: text
children: Without prejudice to any other rights or remedies under the Subcontract the Contractor may by written notice to the Subcontractor summarily determine the Subcontractor’s employment under this Subcontract in respect of the whole or any portion of the Subcontract Works if the Subcontractor:

children.name: text
children: Fails within three days’ notice in writing to proceed regularly and diligently with the Subcontract Works in accordance with the provisions of the Subcontract; or

children.name: text
children: Without reasonable cause wholly suspends carrying out the Subcontract Works before completion thereof; or

children.name: text
children: Refuses or neglects after three days’ notice in writing to remove defective work or improper materials or rectify defects or faults in the Subcontract Works; or

children.name: text
children: Conducts itself in such a manner as to prejudice the completion of the whole or any portion of the Main Contract Works; or

children.name: text
children: Fails to complete and deliver up the whole or any portion of the Subcontract Works by the time or times specified in the Order and/or the Programme, or by such extended time or times as may be allowed by the Contractor; or

children.name: text
children: Makes any arrangements with its creditors, has a receiving Order made against it, executes a Bill of Sale, or commits an act of bankruptcy; or, being a limited company, goes into liquidation, enters into administration, or has a receiver appointed. Indicates verbally, in action or in writing that the company is suffering financial difficulties that may affect the works in preconstruction or construction phase; or

children.name: text
children: Fails within three days following a notice in writing from the Contractor to comply with any of the obligations on the part of the Subcontractor herein contained.

children.name: text
children: Upon termination as aforesaid the Subcontractor shall not be entitled to compensation therefore and shall not remove any of its equipment, materials or property from the Site until completion of the Main Contract Works, and on termination the Subcontractor shall deliver to the Contractor all drawings and other documents and materials (whether in the course of preparation or completed) which are in its possession in connection with the Subcontract Works.

children.name: text
children: On termination no further sum shall become due to the Subcontractor under this Subcontract other than any amount that may become due to it under sub-clause 21.4 and the Contractor need not pay any sum that has already become due either:

children.name: text
children: Insofar as the Contractor has given or gives a Pay Less Notice under sub-clause 11.6 or a Final Pay Less Notice under sub-clause 11.16.3; or

children.name: text
children: If the Subcontractor, after the latest date upon which such notice could have been given by the Contractor in respect of that sum, has become insolvent as defined at Clause 21.1 f).

children.name: text
children: The Contractor shall notify the Subcontractor when practical completion of the Subcontract Works as referred to in Clause 7 has been achieved by the Contractor or other persons engaged by the Contractor (“the First Notice Following Termination”). The Contractor shall further notify the Subcontractor when the rectification of defects has been achieved as referred to in Clause 7 or if appropriate the earlier termination of the Contractor's employment (“the Second Notice Following Termination”). On receipt of the Second Notice Following Termination the Subcontractor may apply to the Contractor and the Contractor shall pay to the Subcontractor the value of works executed, subject always to the rights of the Contractor to set off all loss, expense and damage suffered by the Contractor by reason of such termination.
